name: agentic
description: Building and running agents. loop-design-check gates whether a task deserves a loop, makes the goal machine-decidable and reviews a loop against five failure modes; agent-architecture-audit diagnoses a misbehaving agent stack across twelve layers with severity-ranked, code-first findings; human-gate runs the human sign-off lane of a loop with a single-file review page, a parseable feedback batch and a gate that refuses to close on open blockers; autoresearch-agent runs a Karpathy-style optimize loop that edits one file, evaluates, commits improvements and resets failures; agent-memory is a four-tier CLAUDE.md memory where promotion is earned by recurrence and adopted by a human; stow sweeps a session for durable knowledge and files it into existing CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or TODO conventions with tiered decay; writing-for-agents is the craft of documents agents consume; llm-friendly-context rewrites vague prompt wording into executable instructions; cli-for-agents is the checklist for CLIs agents can run reliably; book-to-skill compiles books and doc folders into progressive-disclosure skills with a validator and token budgets. Contains third-party skills under their own licenses — see NOTICE.md.
